class.name: panoptex_nav::PredictedRiskCritic
class.description: DWB trajectory critic that scores candidate trajectory poses against a time-layered predictive risk field (panoptex_msgs/RiskStack), indexing the risk grid by each pose's own time offset.

class.name: mppi::critics::PredictedRiskCritic
class.description: MPPI critic that scores whole trajectory rollouts against a time-layered predictive risk field (panoptex_msgs/RiskStack), indexing the risk grid by each rollout step's own time offset. Additive cost, never a fail_flag.

class.name: panoptex_nav::PredictedRiskMppiCritic
class.description: Alias of mppi::critics::PredictedRiskCritic under its fully qualified C++ name.
